title: Ad-hoc localization burst plan + contributor matrix (one-pager)
body_text:
Purpose: quick, low-friction tracker to coordinate a 2-week localization surge for a segmented feature launch (in-app UI strings + prompt-localization + eval checks). This spreadsheet is intentionally compact: owner, backup, rough engineering and SE effort, deployment window, and risk flags. Use this as the single source for rapid handoffs and to populate the ops/coverage rota if escalation is required. Non-blocking items should be tracked back to product-ops backlog after the burst.

Notes on usage: 1) Fill 'Owner' who will do final QA and merge localization artifacts. 2) 'Backup' is the person who will take on work if owner is unavailable for >24h. 3) Est. Hours are crude — round up. 4) 'Window' is the preferred deployment/test window; try to keep overlapping windows across regions for infra batching. 5) Tag 'Risk' as low/med/high and add short rationale in Notes column. 6) If SRE capacity is needed, ping #infra-burst and attach this sheet link.
table_rows: Region | Language | Owner | Backup | Est. Hours (eng) | Est. Hours (se) | Window | Risk | Notes
NA | Spanish (MX) | Priya Desai | Marco Alvarez | 18 | 6 | 2029-04-08 to 2029-04-10 | med | glossary missing ~12 strings, prompt variants x3
EU | French (FR) | Marco Alvarez | Jonah Reed | 12 | 4 | 2029-04-09 to 2029-04-11 | low | strings ready, needs translations QA
LATAM | Portuguese (BR) | Jonah Reed | Priya Desai | 20 | 8 | 2029-04-10 to 2029-04-13 | high | large prompt rewrite + locale-specific examples
APAC | Japanese | Mei Tanaka | Ethan Brooks | 14 | 6 | 2029-04-07 to 2029-04-09 | med | date formatting and tokenization checks
EMEA | German (DE) | Ethan Brooks | Nina Kapoor | 10 | 3 | 2029-04-11 to 2029-04-12 | low | small UI copy updates only
NA | Canadian French | Priya Desai | Mei Tanaka | 8 | 2 | 2029-04-12 to 2029-04-13 | low | reuse FR strings, small legal lines
Global | System prompts (en) | Nina Kapoor | Marco Alvarez | 22 | 10 | 2029-04-08 to 2029-04-14 | high | requires eval-run, regression check, and fallback prompts
EMEA | Arabic (Modern Standard) | Samir El-Haji | Jonah Reed | 25 | 10 | 2029-04-09 to 2029-04-16 | high | RTL UI + tokenizer surprises, add native reviewer
quick_estimates: Expected infra spike: +15% token throughput during eval windows
actions: (Owner) Confirm glossary link and add missing strings by 2029-04-04
(Product-ops) Reserve infra window with SRE for 2029-04-08 to 2029-04-14
(SEs) Schedule two regression evals: pre-launch and post-launch (owner: Nina)
(Localization) Recruit 1 native reviewer for Arabic and Portuguese by 2029-04-05
(PM) Triage any high-risk entries into a focused follow-up doc after the burst
postmortem_prompt: After the burst, capture three bullets: what broke, what saved us, and one process change to reduce effort next time. Put results into Confluence LOCAL-289.
